summary: MachinaSense Phase 10 Inference Latency, Concurrency & Sizing Profile

verification_findings.latency_compliance: LSTM achieves warm mean latency of 2.83 ms (median: 2.83 ms, P95: 3.44 ms), satisfying real-time sub-10ms streaming requirements. Random Forest warm mean latency is 102.56 ms (median: 98.05 ms, P95: 133.58 ms). Model loading time is tracked separately from inference latency.
verification_findings.cold_start_overhead: First inference latency: RF first inference is 244.15 ms; LSTM first inference is 14.78 ms. Cold model artifact loading overhead: RF cold load is 5590.52 ms; LSTM cold load is 99.62 ms.
verification_findings.memory_and_disk_footprint: RF artifact (95.19 MB) and LSTM artifact (0.219 MB / 223.8 KB) fit entirely in L3 cache/RAM without disk thrashing.
verification_findings.bounded_predictions: Output clamping layer [0, 125] was verified across 100% of stress and performance test cycles.
